description: Data orchestration pipeline that chains activities (Copy data, Run notebook, Execute pipeline, ForEach loops, If conditions). Similar to Azure Data Factory pipelines. Supports scheduled and event-triggered execution.

definition_parts.description: Pipeline JSON: {"properties":{"activities":[...]}}. An empty pipeline is {"properties":{"activities":[]}}. Verified live.

notes: Create is LRO (returns 202, polls until complete)
For an accurate activities schema, author in the portal once then get-definition to capture the exact activity JSON.
Validate offline before pushing: fabio item validate-definition --type DataPipeline --dir <folder>
